props.gloss_en: the mishna: a priest is believed to say 'I showed this firstborn and it is blemished'
a priest is believed to say 'an Israelite gave me this firstborn with its blemish'
the reason: any matter apt to be revealed, people do not lie about
Rav Ashi: the mishna's reason [for believing the priest] is that any matter apt to be revealed, people do not lie about
the mishna (Demai 4:5): one who tells someone untrusted about tithe 'buy for me from one who is trusted' or 'from one who tithes' -- he is not believed
the same mishna's seifa: [if he said] 'from so-and-so' -- he is believed
R' Yirmeya bar Abba: this is what I said [to Giddul]: an Israelite is believed to say 'I gave this firstborn to a priest with its blemish'
[the Israelite is believed] even where [the firstborn] was small and grew -- lest you say he does not know it for sure

Rafram in Pumbedita gave an unblemished firstborn to a priest; the priest made a blemish in it, brought it before Rafram and said 'an Israelite gave me this firstborn with its blemish'; Rafram forced his eyes open, recognised it, and said: was it not I who gave it to you?
and even so, [Rafram] was not concerned about the matter
this one is the impudent one; everyone [else] is not impudent
Rav Ashi on a sarua brought before him: what should we be concerned about? whether it is a priest or an Israelite, here is a firstborn with its blemish with it
Rav Yehuda: one does not examine an Israelite's firstborn unless a priest is with him
Rav Ashi: there, granted he does not eat sacred meat outside, he is suspect about the priest's money
Rav Ashi: here, since he knows this is a clear blemish, why did they bring it before the Rabbis? for the Sage's honour; [one who] does not neglect the Sage's honour -- will he commit a prohibition?

supports.gloss_en: אף אנן נמי תנינא: a priest is believed to say 'I showed this firstborn and it is blemished' -- is that not because a matter apt to be revealed, people do not lie about?

deflected_by.gloss_en: התם הוא דקדשים בחוץ לא אכיל, אבל הכא כיון דחשידי -- חשידי: there [the mishna's priest] does not eat sacred meat outside; here, since they are suspect, they are suspect

supports.gloss_en: סיפא ודאי מסייעא ליה: 'from so-and-so' -- he is believed

deflected_by.gloss_en: התם כיון דאית ליה תובע מירתת -- there, since he has a claimant, he is afraid

objections.gloss_en: מתיב רב שיזבי: the untrusted agent told 'buy from one who is trusted / who tithes' is not believed -- why? say: any matter apt to be revealed, people do not lie about!

answered_by.gloss_en: שאני התם דאית ליה לאשתמוטי -- there it is different, for he has [a way] to extricate himself (36a.21-36b.1)

objections.gloss_en: Ravina to Rav Ashi: perhaps it is an Israelite, and Rav Yehuda said one does not examine an Israelite's firstborn unless a priest is with him! (an amoraic-memra contradiction; kind svara under protest)

answered_by.gloss_en: הכי השתא -- there he is suspect about the priest's money; here, bringing a clear blemish before the Rabbis is for the Sage's honour, and one who keeps the Sage's honour will not commit a prohibition (36b.11-12; = p_ashi_chashud_mamon_kohen, p_ashi_kevod_chacham)

rulings.gloss_en: והלכתא אפילו כלישנא קמא -- the halakha is even as the first version (the priest too is believed)
